literal_meaning: যাওয়ার জন্য বসা (to sit to go)
figurative_meaning_en: on the verge of ruin or destruction
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসা দেখার লোকের অভাবে যেতে বসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business is on the verge of ruin due to lack of customers.
In this situation, the exam is about to go down the drain.
note: This idiom reflects everyday concerns in Bengali socio-economic contexts, often used in discussions of livelihood and stability.
